title: Measured large gaps between rune lines
question: Do fixed original-image measurements reproduce the reported 109-pixel large gap, ordinary 73-pixel gaps, and 129-pixel parable exception?
summary: Four frozen image regions reproduce the scale of the claim: LP2-04 has a 109-pixel gap, LP2-35 a 110-pixel gap, LP2-57 a 129-pixel gap, and the LP2-14 comparison has only 73–75-pixel gaps.

scope.representation: Fixed rectangles in four hashed 2400×3600 source JPEGs, measured as wholly blank horizontal pixel rows between runic ink-row bands.
scope.procedure: Declare source-labeled pages and rectangular rune regions, threshold grayscale rows, merge within-line ink bands, count every intervening blank-row run, and repeat at three darkness thresholds. Verify with an independent flat-pixel projection.
scope.parameters: Rectangles in plan.json; five dark pixels to activate a row; at most 14 blank rows joined within a printed line; grayscale cutoffs 100, 160 and 200.
scope.exclusions: Full 16-page source classification, original Canva crop coordinates, punctuation causation, source typesetting software, bitstream or decipherment.

finding: At all three thresholds, LP2-04 has one 109-pixel gap and ten 73–75-pixel gaps; LP2-35 one 110-pixel gap and ten 73–75-pixel gaps; LP2-57 one 129-pixel gap and three 73–74-pixel gaps; and LP2-14 six 73–75-pixel gaps.
limitations: The four image regions are source-guided selections, not a random or whole-book census. The original post's screenshot coordinates are unavailable, so exact agreement with its measurement method cannot be established. Different page layouts prevent a causal conclusion from the spacing alone.
next_steps: Annotate rune-row bounding boxes across all reported big-gap and comparison pages before measuring the punctuation association; preserve exact page and row coordinates and compare within consistent layouts.

review.reviewer: Fixed-region replay and independent flat-pixel projection; source images visually checked

reproduction.environment: Python 3.12 and Pillow 11.3.0; original-images.zip extracted at the repository root. Also run check.py and plot.py --check.

visuals.caption: Each point is a measured clear gap between adjacent ink-row bands in one fixed original-image crop; red marks exceed 100 pixels.
